This is github.com/simonvetter/modbus v1.6.4 under MIT (LICENSE.txt in this
directory), minus its tests, its examples and its command line tool, with one
change. Flow's go.mod replaces the module with this directory.

Why: the client opens its TCP and UDP sockets with net.DialTimeout, and gives
no way to open them any other way. The Shepherd Boy Farms box has one port that
carries twelve VLANs, each with the same 192.168.1.0/24 and the same device
addresses. A socket there has to be bound to one VLAN's interface with
SO_BINDTODEVICE before it connects, or the kernel picks whichever of the twelve
routes it likes. The binding belongs to the socket, so it cannot be done around
the client. The copy is the fix.

Change, and only this, in client.go:

  * ClientConfiguration has one more field, Dialer, a func(network, address
    string, timeout time.Duration) (net.Conn, error).
  * ModbusClient has one more method, dial, which calls Dialer when it is set
    and net.DialTimeout when it is not.
  * The four net.DialTimeout calls in Open (rtuovertcp, rtu+udp, tcp, tcp+udp)
    call dial instead. The TLS mode is not changed.

With Dialer unset the behavior is the upstream's, byte for byte.

When upstream takes a dialer, the copy goes and go.mod returns to the upstream
module.
